name: Blast radius card shows the degraded badge on the unindexed seed repo
description: From PR #482 (Overview tab is the default), confirm the 'Blast radius' card renders and, because the seed repo has clonePath: null and is never indexed, shows the 'Index incomplete' badge with the no_data reason sentence. Deterministic (R10): the seed repo can never reach an indexed state, so this never depends on an LLM call or on the index job running. Numbered 10 because 08 is reserved and 09 is smart-diff.
